no_category: No category found. Try another term.
system_language_desc: Automatic follows the language currently selected in the game. If its file is missing, the interface uses English.
system_preview_desc: This sample visually confirms the applied language and checks accented letters or special characters.
section_subtitle_summary: Overview of the current difficulty profile.
section_subtitle_player: Settings that directly change Hornet's experience.
section_subtitle_damage: Attack, Silk Skill, and combat damage settings.
section_subtitle_enemies: Health, movement, attack rate, and awareness of common enemies.
section_subtitle_enemy_editor: Individual settings for catalogued enemies and Bosses.
section_subtitle_movement: Hornet movement speed and dash recharge time.
section_subtitle_mutators: Independent special rules applied over normal settings.
section_subtitle_system: Language selection and general menu actions.
footer_shortcuts: Q / E  NAVIGATE     CTRL + F  SEARCH     F8 / ESC  CLOSE
desc_needle_upgrade_percentage: Applies the percentage cumulatively to every Needle upgrade acquired.
system_apply_desc: Confirms every edited value and makes the current state the new restore point for Discard Changes.
system_reset_desc: Restores every category to the current profile defaults. Favorites are preserved.
system_discard_desc: Returns exactly to the state from when the menu was opened or Apply Changes was last used.
system_close_desc: Commits fields being edited, closes the interface, and returns control to Hornet.
preset_load_file_desc: {0} file(s) found in the Presets folder. Load adds the file to Your Presets without enabling it.
preset_save_file_desc: Saves every current setting from every tab to a new JSON and adds it to Your Presets.
preset_refresh_desc: Reads the JSON files from the mod folder again. Active preset: {0}.
desc_preset_very_easy: A major advantage for Hornet, fragile enemies, generous economy, and no Rosary loss.
desc_preset_very_hard: Higher incoming damage, limited healing, restrictive economy, and greatly strengthened opponents.
your_presets_empty: No file has been loaded into this list. Use Load File above.
your_preset_desc: Enables every setting in this file. Remove only hides it from the tab; its JSON remains in the Presets folder.
desc_reset_mutators: Disables every mutator without changing values configured in other categories.
locked_future_desc: This setting is reserved for a future stage.
desc_silk_skills_section: Individual Silk costs and damage for all six Silk Skills. Default values reproduce build 1.0.30000.
desc_silk_spear_entry: One piercing hit. Vanilla formula: current Needle damage × 3.00.
desc_thread_storm_entry: Separate hits every 6 physics steps. The multiplier changes after 0.5 seconds.
desc_cross_stitch_entry: A four-hit counterattack created only after a successful defense.
desc_sharpdart_entry: Uses one 2.75x damage hit for each enemy pierced.
desc_rune_rage_entry: Nine independent runes. Repeated-hit reduction is tracked separately per enemy.
desc_pale_nails_entry: Three independent projectiles, each using the current Needle damage.
desc_red_tools_section: Active devices such as projectiles, traps, and bombs; uses are replenished with Shell Shards.
desc_blue_tools_section: Passive defensive and offensive upgrades: extra protection, hazard resistance, and status effects.
desc_yellow_tools_section: Passive offensive or support upgrades that strengthen attacks and exploration advantages.
desc_health: Sets Hornet’s maximum health from 1 to 20 masks.
desc_damage: Sets the Needle’s base damage from 1 to 100.
desc_silk_spear_damage_multiplier: Sets Silk Spear damage from 1.0x to 20.0x; its normal value is 3.0x Needle damage.
desc_silk_cost_multiplier: Sets this skill’s individual Silk cost from 1 to 18.
desc_skill_damage_multiplier: Sets the damage multiplier for this specific Silk Skill hit.
desc_damage_taken: Adds damage to enemy attacks and projectiles.
desc_environmental_damage_multiplier: Adds damage to spikes, acid, lava, traps, and other environmental hazards.
desc_one_hit_mode: Any damaging hit removes all of Hornet’s normal and blue health.
desc_healing_multiplier: Directly sets how many masks Bind restores, from 1 to 20.
desc_healing_cost_multiplier: Sets Bind’s real Silk cost from 1 to 18.
desc_invincibility_time_multiplier: Multiplies invincibility duration after damage and during defensive techniques.
desc_enemy_health_multiplier: Multiplies common-enemy maximum health; identified Bosses are not changed.
desc_enemy_speed_multiplier: Multiplies common-enemy physical movement speed from 0.1x to 1.1x.
desc_enemy_attack_cooldown_multiplier: Higher values shorten the intervals between common-enemy attacks.
desc_enemy_aggression_multiplier: Multiplies common-enemy detection, alert, and pursuit distances.
desc_boss_health_multiplier: Multiplies the maximum health of each identified Boss.
desc_boss_damage_taken_multiplier: Multiplies damage Hornet receives from Boss attacks and projectiles.
desc_boss_speed_multiplier: Multiplies Boss physical movement speed from 0.1x to 1.1x.
desc_boss_attack_cooldown_multiplier: Higher values shorten Boss attack intervals, up to 2.0x.
desc_boss_brutal_mode: Boss attacks have a 10% chance to deal 1 extra mask; healing restores 1 fewer mask during Bosses.
desc_disable_healing_during_boss: Bind can consume Silk but restores no masks during an active Boss fight.
desc_healing_during_boss_multiplier: Multiplies the configured healing amount only during Boss fights.
desc_currency_drop_multiplier: Multiplies Rosaries earned when collecting coins.
desc_item_drop_multiplier: Multiplies the Rosary reward earned when collecting fragments.
desc_shop_price_multiplier: Multiplies Rosary prices in compatible shops, benches, or stations.
desc_death_currency_loss_multiplier: Sets Rosary loss on death from 0% to 200%; the balance can become negative.
desc_player_speed_multiplier: Multiplies Hornet’s walking and running speed from 0.1x to 2.0x.
desc_dash_cooldown_multiplier: Level 1 is normal; level 2 takes 0.1 seconds, and every later level doubles the time.
desc_mutator_no_healing: Hornet cannot heal during the entire run.
desc_mutator_double_damage: Enemies and environmental hazards deal double damage; Hornet keeps normal damage.
desc_mutator_glass_cannon: Locks health at 1 and damage at 30; every mask shard grants 1,000 Rosaries.
desc_mutator_aggressive_enemies: Raises enemy aggression and speed to 1.1x.
desc_mutator_randomized_enemy_health: Randomizes each enemy’s health between 0.1x and 5.0x.
desc_mutator_expensive_shops: Multiplies shop and station prices by 10.
desc_mutator_no_death_loss: No Rosaries are lost and no cocoon appears on death.
desc_mutator_boss_frenzy: Bosses deal double damage and move at 1.1x speed.
desc_mutator_no_mercy: On death, all Rosaries are lost and Hornet returns to the start of the game.
desc_mutator_extended_fights: Bosses deal 1 mask of damage and have 10 times more health.
favorites_empty_description: Open a category and use a setting's star to create a quick shortcut.
favorite_card_description: This shortcut keeps the same controls as the original setting.
already_default_tooltip: This setting already uses the default
restore_confirm_description: Every change in the current profile will return to its default. Favorites and preset files will be preserved.
